messages.text: Beta, I put dates and pakoras aside for you. If storm call keeps you out, tell me before maghrib so I do not wait.
Keep mine in the oven if I'm late. Crew is still saying maybe another feeder after 6.
The khala group is asking if you joined the video call Sunday. Also don't just drink coffee before sunrise, thora sa paratha at least.
I saw the WhatsApp thread. I'll call Sunday and I'll eat something real before shift.
Beta, Ayesha said there may be street closures near Oakland tomorrow evening. If you drive after work, keep your license and insurance card where you can reach them.
I keep both in the visor now. If anyone stops me, I just answer short and don't reach around.
Good. Also do not go alone if people are standing around after dark. Come home for dinner first if you can.
I'll probably just meet Ayesha for chai after. She wanted to talk about that campus panel from last week.
Bring your one-line print tomorrow. They changed the feeder note after lunch.
Already put it in the truck folder. I want to trace it before we roll so nobody is guessing at the pole.
Good. Slow walk the switching order, call each step out, and make the new guy repeat it back.
That's what I was thinking. Also still want to ask you about that hall info night after shift.
You make it back? Rain made the ramps ugly.
Yeah. Had to circle Telegraph twice but got a spot under the laundromat light by 50th.
Good. Leave the work bag out of sight.
Already trunked it. Walking past the bus stop with one ear open because the jackhammer crew is still going.
You got a minute? Still replaying that Penn Hills call. I keep thinking I should have moved faster.
Call me after you park. We walk the steps, not the movie in your head.
Thanks. I almost typed it into that crew page but deleted it.
Good. Some stuff belongs between people who were there or know you. Procedure first, noise last.
My uncle Nadeem found that old photo from the yard walk-through. You look like you borrowed the hard hat from a museum.
That was right after the CCAC parking sticker era. I had no idea what I was doing.
He still brags that giving you Dave's number worked out better than his own resume advice.
Tell him I still owe him fries for that. First week in the yard was rough but it stuck.
Use the hand cart if they send you with the big cable reels today. No need to prove anything.
I know. Keeping the bag lighter too. Upper side still gets stiff by the end of storm shifts.
And bend with knees. You remember after that awkward gear lift last year, they had you doing easier pulls for some days.
Yeah, only for a bit. I have been normal schedule since then, just stretching before we roll out.
When you come Sunday, bring that small tester from your trunk. The basement light by Ayesha's old shelves is flickering again.
I can bring it. Same corner where my school boxes are?
Yes. I checked the switch but want you to see the wire color before I open more. Old trade-school habit.
Got it. I'll stop by the Monroeville house after Maghrib.
That gray page you put on your story was actually nice. Was that behind the busway?
Near the old brick row by the service alley. I liked the pole shadows more than the building.
Of course you made wires and cracked walls look moody lol. One of those tiny Lawrenceville art accounts reposted something like that today.
Yeah I follow a few of those. Their posts give me better corners to look for.
Send me the clip from that tiny place in Bloomfield if you go. The one with the red lights looked cool last time.
Maybe. It is a 40-person room, so my phone feels rude if I hold it up too long.
Lol 8 seconds is enough. Also I sent you that tanpura + rain loop for your pencil hours.
That one is already queued with the gray notebook.
I found a small plastic box from your school days in the hall closet. It has tiny bulbs, wires, and old instruction cards. Keep or throw away?
Keep it for now please. That box is the one where I first got the red bulb to light after messing up the clips about 20 times.
Then take it from here on Sunday. Also no more little packets arriving here, beta. The drawer is full.
Fair. I only need the loose resistors from it. I was checking a build thread and mine uses the same values.
You still replaying that feeder job from last night?
A little. I wrote down the steps we actually took and what I would check sooner next time. That helped.
Good. Review the work, don't beat yourself up. Also you asked about that used vise. If the jaws line up, $55 is fine.
Might grab it. Saving stuff for a real bench someday, not just the apartment table.
I looked at the Oakmont feeder print again after dinner. The tie point still bugs me even though the crew lead signed off.
Print matched the field tags. You confirmed it with Nate and the dispatcher. Write those three things down and leave it there.
Yeah. I keep replaying the step where we moved cones by the alley.
Useful review is one pass. After that you are just wearing grooves in the same spot.
You free after shift Friday? I can do Primanti's or just bring fries over.
Depends if they keep me late. If I'm out by 7, your place works.
Cool. I still have that old black-and-gold playoff recording saved, unless you want to rewatch the OT from last night on ice.
Let's see how tired I am. Either one with food is fine.
Portal asking before my Friday checkup: bring all bottles, even daily ones?
Yes, take what you actually use. I keep my list blank except Tylenol once in a while, so yours is different.
Also your chacha sent that voice note about skipping the clinic shot.
Ask Dr. Sadiq Friday and use the UPMC page, not the forwarded clip. I can print the page after work.
Your mother put the cousin engagement photos on FB. She says you did not see them.
I only opened it to check her tag. I saw the photos and then got out before the council fight thread started.
Good. No need to read that late. Also send me that breaker panel page you showed me.
I'll text it. It came from the trade account I saved, not FB.
my laptop did the black screen thing again right before stats review 🙃
Hold power 15 sec, then try the charger from the left port. Send me a pic if the light stays amber.
it booted. also sending you this campus dining meme because it is literally Dad's face when the naan is store-bought
Do not show him Sunday unless you want a lecture at dinner.
Beta, Sunday come by 4:30. I am making pulao and kheer, and Ayesha wants you to bring the green envelopes from the drawer.
I can come after my shift. I will grab the envelopes and the box from Target too.
Good. Also pick fresh ginger and honey if you pass Patel Brothers. Your voice sounded rough yesterday.
Okay, I will stop there. Need anything for Abu's plate?
Roundabout Brewery has that small show tonight. You still coming or did family claim you?
Coming for a bit. I told home I already had plans, so I'll do one pint with food and head out before it gets packed.
Solid. I'll grab the back table away from the speakers and the loud people.
Perfect. Also don't tag me in anything from there, my aunties watch everything.
Beta, yesterday did you put something away first or did the card start talking already?
I moved 425 before breakfast. Paid gas and the phone after that.
Good. February had those long weather calls, but do not make the regular bills expect 4300.
Yeah, I set March like 3900 and left the extra alone.
Beta, storm week again. Please eat before coffee and do not drink it late like last time.
I know. I stopped after noon today and did the 10-minute sit when I got home.
Beta, are you coming for dinner tomorrow or did they keep you again after the storm?
I am supposed to be off at 3:30, but they told crew 3A to keep phones on until noon tomorrow.
Good. Also did you call the number from the insurance portal or still only looking?
Still looking. It says $95 each time until deductible, so I am checking a couple more names first.
Then eat before you go. Do not stand outside all morning with only coffee in your stomach.
I packed food and dry socks. If I get released on time I will bring naan on the way.
Saw your note about the Rouge plant. If you go back up there, wear real shoes. Those old floors and rails are no joke.
Yeah, I was only saving links. Put another $9 aside this morning, so this is still a slow thing.
Slow is fine. You also sent me that mountain permit page last week. That one looks like a whole different pace.
That page is staying in the folder. No crew, no rush, just leaving it there for later.
Coffee at 11 or are you still doing that Frick thing?
Frick first. Muddy by the lower path so I might be slow getting back.
Cool, I will push it to 11:30. Don't show up with half the park on your shoes.
No promises. I have a towel in the trunk this time.
Primanti's after the game or are you on that home-pan thing again?
Home tonight. I already made rice and chickpeas with the spice mix, plus a sheet pan of peppers.
Respect. I was gonna suggest the place with the weird IPAs too, but we can just watch at mine.
That works. I am leaving the four-packs and the little soldering kit alone until next check clears.
Check the front tires before you go across the river. Rain all morning.
I did. Tread is okay but the brake quote came back higher than I wanted.
Brakes first. Other things can wait if they are not hurting badly.
Yeah. I moved Feldman's slot again so I can keep the car solid for work.
If you go to that evening lab, check parking first. After work you will not want to circle the lot.
I found the envelope from Forbes Avenue. Your mother kept everything from the hospital.
Yeah, the Tuesday one starts 6:30. I can make it if I am not held for storm cleanup.
Does it have the one with 9/14/01 on it? The portal wants the raised-seal scan.
Ask them if the Allen-Bradley practice counts toward the card. Do not pay twice for same material.
Yes. Also old papers with our first Monroeville address after we came here. Do you need those?
Yeah, and leave the extra proof box empty for now. I only have school, work, and tax papers for that timeline.
I wrote that down. Also checking whether the first semester can stay at two nights only.
I know you saw that body-cam clip from Wilkinsburg. The comments are already trash.
My feet still hurt from yesterday lol. You were so serious holding that sign like it was a clipboard at work.
I just wanted to stand there, listen, and not turn it into content.
Yeah. I started a reply then closed it. Dinner later? Easier to talk when it's just us.
Fine, but don't do your quiet nod thing the whole time. People keep pretending certain neighborhoods get treated the same.
Fair. Also that speaker had a point about the city posting actual stop data instead of another shiny task force page.
Yeah. Show the numbers, fund the response teams, and stop hiding behind committees.
I'm listening. Send me the council link too.
send me whatever sleepy playlist you had on at dinner, not the loud one
It was a YT mix. I had it under a guy drawing relay boxes on a whiteboard lol
of course you had homework-looking stuff behind music
Only for a little. He got to the rung with the timer bit and I wanted to finish it.
For Sunday dinner, should I set one plate for you or are you bringing anyone?
Just me. Daniel and Marcus are doing their own thing after I drop off the utility checks.
Okay beta. Bring the mail from your apartment too if there is anything from the office.
I will. The envelope only has the three renewal pages, so I can carry it over.
Beta, when you come for dinner bring Abbu's portal printout. Also did you look at that spring ballot paper you left on the table?
Yeah, I marked the judges section but still need to read the county guide for the school board names.
Good. And please check Dr. Rao's message about the new shot before your father asks me again.
I will. I'm not taking random screenshots from the cousins chat as my source.
What time should I keep dinner for you? Your father said Maghrib is around 7.
Around 6:30. Dryer is running and I still need to put the boots and glove liners near the door.
Bring the blue containers back if you have them. And do not forget clean socks for the early shift.
Already put those with the lunch bag. I am bringing the containers too.
Before Sunday, check the car account. If it still says near $7,000, do not add extra tools this week.
It is $7,046 after the last pull. I already moved $450 aside Friday, so I am keeping the rest boring.
Good. Also remember the room money and utilities are separate. Do not mix them.
Yeah, $850 first, utilities after. I paid the small Visa charge too.
Beta, did you eat something besides coffee today?
Had eggs before shift. I'll grab rice after this call.
Good. Also the Highmark page has a new message. Can you read it tonight and tell me what they are asking?
Send the screenshot after work. If it needs the login code, call me.
That auntie at dinner really said more patrol cars fixes everything 😭
Yeah I didn't want to get loud at the table. But if the rec center closes at 6 and the clinic wait is 3 months, everyone acts shocked later.
Exactly. Also you got quiet when uncle brought up the 2020 marches.
Because I remember watching all that and then still thinking about how I'm read when I have my work hoodie and beard.
Did you listen to that album yet or are the upstairs footsteps winning
I started it on the 18 bus, but once I got off by Children’s the street got too loud for both earbuds.
You and your one-ear commute lol. Still better than that old radiator orchestra.
The radiator plus the plywood crew across the alley is a whole remix.
Bring the heavier gloves. The north feeder job got bumped ahead of the easy meter list.
Saw that. I was counting on the normal route today.
Normal route is the plan until the map starts blinking. Meet at bay 4 after the tailboard.
Copy. I will grab the hot stick bag before we pull out.
For that crew profile, upload the OSHA card, flagger cert, and the Allegheny County work history. Don't overthink the optional boxes.
One page asks for years outside PA and another wants a document I don't have.
Then mark the years page as zero and keep moving. Optional means optional.
Got it. My list is just Monroeville, Pittsburgh, and the storm-call addresses since I started.
Primanti's Friday or are you on storm standby again?
Standby. Also trying not to spend extra until I sort the car and that Feldman estimate.
Your mom would probably spot you and then text you a spreadsheet by 7 am.
Exactly why I'm not asking. I'll pick up another Saturday shift before that.
Coffee after your appointment thing Saturday? Also Omar keeps sending group-chat miracle cures again lol.
Yeah. It is just the employee health update and paperwork. No bottles to bring, so it should be quick.
Please don't argue with Omar for 40 messages.
I just sent him the Allegheny County page and said to ask his clinic if he is unsure.
You still awake or did the pencil-and-headphones ritual win?
Awake. Finishing a page of rooflines while that 18-minute no-vocal thing loops.
Send it if it is not top secret. Also was that clip from Saturday the same Penn Ave room?
Yeah, second act. I only caught the last chorus because the room was packed.
Roads wet today. If bucket work is long, skip the fast. Safety first.
I packed water just in case. Starting with eggs and chai now.
Good. Your nana used to say niyyat matters, not showing off. Check gloves also.
Gloves, boots, and hard hat are in the truck. I'll be smart about it.
Your work boots still dry? Also check the tread on those black sneakers.
Boots are fine. Sneakers are getting smooth, mostly from Schenley mornings.
Replace before you slip. Community center has that discount board near the desk.
I saw it after lockers yesterday. I will look again after work.
Did you check the diagram before touching that transformer today?
Yes. Meter readings were weird, so I stopped and had Rob read them back before we moved anything.
Good. In maintenance, rushing makes small mistakes expensive. What is this meeting paper on your table?
Just the Local 29 visitor sheet. Mostly want to hear how their classes and checkoffs work.
why are you liking my reel at 12:40 lol
Couldn’t shut it off. Kept going back through the Penn Hills call in my head.
Did anything actually go wrong or are you doing the courtroom thing with yourself again
Nothing went wrong. I just keep landing on the same two choices and checking the map photo.
Did you fill out that county form yet or are you doing the usual thing where you care about the race two days too late
Rude but fair. I set a reminder. I want the local ones to stop sneaking past me.
Also you always say no team jersey, then you circle the person with the housing/transit answer I would pick lol
Because the answers matter more than the sticker. Send me that campus comparison sheet if it has sources.
Beta, that portal is showing CO-45 again. I told your father I used to see that code every week at the desk.
Send me the screenshot and I will check after lunch.
I sent it. My old office-training notebook explains half of this better than their website.
I remember that notebook from the kitchen drawer in Monroeville.
Are you coming Sunday? If you are tired, bring nothing. Just eat properly, beta.
I can come. I have lentils soaking and eggs boiled, so I can bring a container if you want.
Good. Use cumin and a little chili, not only hot sauce. Did you cancel that show ticket?
Yeah, I let it go. I am keeping March quiet and using what is already in the kitchen.
Beta, I saw the envelope on your table with the campus name. Did you send the form or only print it?
Only printed. I need the tax info and my March shifts before I submit anything.
Bring it Sunday. We can look after dinner. Do not choose a plan that makes you live on extra shifts.
That is exactly what I am trying to avoid long term.
Crew meeting at 7:20. Bring up the cracked hot sticks and the ladder tie-off issue if they ask for open items.
I wrote it down. No point in a safety board if the same gear keeps coming back with tape on it.
Exactly. Say it plain: fix the gear, document the fix, no speeches.
That is the kind of meeting I trust. The ones with minutes, repairs, and someone signing off.
You heading by PPG tomorrow? Traffic by Centre gets stupid when there's a 7 o'clock puck drop.
Yeah, Sameer grabbed two seats. I'm trying to leave early enough to not sprint from the garage.
Good. Take the win where you can get it. And don't park on the wrong side of Fifth unless you like paying extra.
Noted. I already got burned once down there.
You home from the call?
Yeah. I wrote down the steps, ran two miles, and I am putting the phone in the kitchen tonight.
Good. Review the job once, then leave it. Did you ever use that EAP lookup I sent?
Opened it three times. Haven't picked anyone. The free ones are only two visits and the regular price jumps after that.
You still trying to pick up those Saturday router installs my cousin mentioned?
Nah. If the utility hours run long, that is enough. I am not adding another place to track.
Fair. Coffee after your next Friday bank-hit ritual then?
After I move the first chunk and see what the stub says. If it is closer to 3800 this time, still coffee, cheaper table.
Coffee tomorrow or are you reading about abandoned brick places again?
Coffee. The brick places can wait. I did find a Cleveland-to-Detroit notes thread though.
Of course you did. Did the tiny envelope survive payday?
$11 survived. Also added one page about Thimphu buses, then closed all the tabs before I got carried away.
How are those boots holding? If the sole is opening, do not wait until rain.
They are okay for now. I ordered laces, socks, and the thinner liners you mentioned.
Good. Put the new ones with your bag when they come, otherwise you will look for them at 5 in the morning.
Yeah, shelf by the sketchbooks for extras, door hook for tomorrow stuff.
Did you look at that house? Basement dry?
Mostly dry. Panel looked labeled right, but I want an inspector before I trust it.
Good. Don't let agent rush you. And Sunday your mother wants you here before Maghrib.
I'll come early. Just not staying for the cousin matchmaking talk again if it turns into a whole plan.
FYI Mom is inviting half of Monroeville for Sunday. I told her you might only stay for the first plates.
Thank you. I can help set up and eat with everyone, but I can't do three hours of auntie questions.
Fair. Also wear the plain jacket lol. The bottle-cap patch one will start a whole committee meeting.
Already learned that lesson. I'll keep it simple and still bring the naan.
Beta, I put the heating pad on the chair near the door. Take it with you if you are sleeping at home after work.
Thanks. It is mostly from being bent over cabinets and riding in the truck all day.
Do not skip dinner and then say your back is bothering you. Also tell me if the old work paper needs a copy from the clinic.
No copy needed right now. They only asked if anything changed since that short stretch last year.
Bring your 70E printout Monday. Office lost half the crew files again.
Got it. Same folder as the OSHA card and the old orientation sheet Dave signed.
Dave from Nadeem's lead? Yeah. Keep that sheet. First contractor paperwork disappears when people switch trailers.
I scanned it this time. Learned after the first winter.
That clip you mentioned about the old padmount cutaway was good. The comments had a better link for load tap changers too.
Good. Just remember the real cabinet is less clean than a video with perfect lighting.
Yeah. I saved one on smart reclosers for after laundry, then I am done for the night.
Fine with me. Watch, take two notes, then close the laptop.
Primanti's after the late game or are you doing the spreadsheet monk thing again
Spreadsheet first. Last month landed around $2,300 for me, so I am trying not to wreck March with fries and coffee.
Fair. You still doing that $400-ish transfer every check cycle?
More like $500 this month if nothing weird hits. I also want the car number under $7k soon.
Coffee after the game or is the apartment chaos tonight?
Quiet here. Daniel's at his cousin's, Marcus is at work, and I already paid my third of the bills.
So no extra people eating the couch space. Big upgrade.
Yeah, just the usual three-key situation. I can meet at 10 if you're still up.
Your mother says you are taking the old kit box. Some wires are brittle. Do not plug anything into wall power.
I know. This is all USB power and the tiny board. I just wanted the breadboard and the old red diode for nostalgia.
That red one gave you big excitement in 7th grade. You showed me three times after dinner.
Because it finally worked. Funny that now I still end up staring at pin diagrams from strangers before touching anything.
Coffee after 3? Also I saw you saved that account with all the rusted stair shots.
I sent you that new Lawrenceville taco place from the photo app. Also the climbing gym posted March guest passes.
3:30 works. That account had a good one of the old mill windows on the South Side.
Saw both. My saves are all food, old mill shots, rope walls, and work stuff lately.
Better than the mayor-race replies. I almost sent you one and then remembered your 10 pm rule.
You gonna turn it into another tiny notebook page and pretend you hate attention when you upload it?
Yeah, send food instead. I'll read actual news earlier, not the midnight pile-on.
Maybe. The windows and the pole lines were clean.
Your mother says bring the navy one, not the old gray shirt. Pictures will happen after lunch.
The navy kurta still fits. I just need to iron it.
Okay. And don't forget the tea things she asked. She has been boiling that ginger again.
I have honey in the car already. I will be there before noon.
My throat is still cooked from Saturday lol. Worth it though.
Same. That last rush made the whole week less annoying.
Next time we balance it with couch food and one of those old Sunday recordings. Less stairs.
Deal, if work doesn't steal the afternoon.
Beta, I put your baby file next to the green folder. It has Magee papers and the small card from September 2001.
Thanks. I also need Abbu's old arrival copies for the family section, if they're in the closet.
They are there, with Karachi stamps and our first lease in Monroeville. Please do not lose them.
I won't. The rest of the packet is just my school, W-2, and utility job pages.
Porch light flickers again. Breaker not tripped.
Leave it off for now. I'll bring the tester when I come by after Maghrib.
Ok. Also check tire pressure before Sunday, cold mornings are low.
I checked yesterday. I'll still top them off before heading over.
Coffee at Redhawk after your shift? Or are you still doing the cautious driving home thing after that taillight stop?
Redhawk works. And yeah, I fixed the bulb. I just keep both hands visible and don't joke around in those moments.
Fair. We can talk about that Wilkinsburg meeting too. My cousin said half the comments were about funding youth stuff before the night calls pile up.
That's the part people skip. They only notice the final call, not everything missing before it.
You got quiet after that council clip. Same face you had junior year before the calc final lol.
I had a whole post typed and it sounded like bait. Rather run it by you first.
Send it here. Or we do fries tomorrow and edit it down to human words.
Fries works. Ayesha already sent me three links and a lecture.
Mom says wear the green kurta tonight, not the wrinkled black one from the closet lol.
Tell her I can iron it after work. Are the cousins still doing the group call before dinner?
Yeah, WhatsApp at 6:15. Also chachu's family is bringing biryani so don't buy random pizza.
Fine, no pizza. I'll try to stop at the hall first if shift lets me out clean.
I found the sarod recording Abbu used to play in the car. Sending before I forget.
That opening drone is perfect for line work. I will use it after dinner.
Your notebooks are going to be 90% chimneys and wires at this point.
Add one crooked Bloomfield stage corner from last week.
Beta, you answered my WhatsApp at 3:12. Did you rest before work?
A little. I had the Highland Park diagram open and lost track of time.
No more coffee before leaving. Eat the eggs I packed. You cannot go to the yard on empty.
I will. The plan for the backfeed makes sense now, so I’m done looking at it.
Beta, Sunday dinner is at 5:30. Your uncle's family may also come. Please tell me early if you cannot stay late.
I can come at 5:30 and help with dishes. I may leave around 7 if it turns into the whole living-room crowd.
Okay. Just sit with your father a little, he wants to ask about your work classes. And don't skip eating properly.
I will. I'll bring the rice container back too.
Beta, Khalida aunty sent another long message. She says the clinic reminder is unnecessary and has a video.
Send it to me. I will answer nicely. The reminder from St. Clair has the date and the doctor can confirm it.
Also they ask on the form what you take every day. You still write nothing?
Yes, same as last time. Just write the occasional Advil if they ask about pain stuff.
Bring the better gloves today. Wet ladder work, no rushing clips.
Packed them. Also leaving early because the car squeal came back under 30 mph.
Good. A late start beats a bad stop. Get the estimate in writing.
That's the plan. Same thing I should've done with Feldman's quote instead of guessing what the card covers.
Campus maker sale has cheap LEDs today. Do you want me to grab you anything?
Mom put you on tray duty again lol. She said no disappearing after the first round.
Skip me. I still have that unopened breadboard kit, and I am trying not to add random stuff.
I am helping. I already carried the big pot and the boxes from my trunk.
Okay sensible brother era. What are you eating then, instant noodles?
Also your new cream outfit actually looks good. Please do not spill qorma on it in the first 20 minutes.
Not noodles. Chickpeas, rice, roasted cauliflower, and a fried egg if I get home before ten.
Too late if the little cousins attack the sweets table.
Do you still have that photo where I'm tiny and you're in the Gateway hoodie on the porch?
Maybe in the blue bin at Mom and Dad's. Why?
Class project. Also Dad's certificate from the vo-tech wall would be perfect next to Mom's old reception-window badge.
I'll look Sunday if the bin is still under the steps.
Beta, Auntie Noreen asked if you can come for dinner next Friday. Her niece will be there also.
I can come for dinner if it's just dinner. Please don't make it a meeting.
I understand. We just want good people around you. Also your father said measure before buying heavy tools.
I know. I'll bring dessert Sunday and take the basement measurements later, no impulse buys.
Saw you grab the winch line left-handed today. Smart. Keep the young-guy hero stuff out of it.
Trying. After six hours my right side starts locking up if I keep reaching overhead.
Rotate jobs before it gets cranky. Remember last winter when they moved you off the awkward lifts for a few shifts? That was the right call.
Yeah. I did not miss time, just had to stop being stubborn with gear placement.
You still coming for fries or did City Council's 900-page PDF win?
Almost done. The boring parts matter: grid upgrades, bridge money, stormwater stuff, not just ribbon photos.
Only you read the appendix before Primanti's.
I sent $10 to the group that posted the plain-English breakdown. That is my civic budget for the week.
Fries this late or are you pretending to sleep
I can do 20 min. Waiting for the group of students from the corner cafe to clear out so I can move the car under the bright meter.
Oakland parking chess. Respect.
Construction fences ate half the block again, and the 6 stop is packed with scrubs.
Did your work money come yesterday? Boots can wait if the tires need it first.
It landed. I already moved my usual 425, then paid insurance. Tires are next.
Good. Do not count on overtime every month. March should be normal.
Yeah, I am treating it like 4k max unless the crew hours prove otherwise.
Can you bring my laptop charger tonight? I left it at your place by the little shelf.
Got it. It is next to the sketchbooks, above the extra socks and liners.
Also mom said come before 7 if you want food hot.
I will. Need to finish laundry and charge the new headlamp first.
Beta, I put your cousin's baby announcement on FB and tagged you. Please just say mashallah when you see it.
I saw it. I'll comment there for family stuff, but I'm not putting my whole day on there.
That is fine. Your auntie only wants relatives to see.
Good. If I need to talk something through, I'll call or text one person, not put it in a status.
You still looking at that crew forum thread about cutouts? Somebody posted a decent answer about ice loading.
Yeah, I saved it. Same account I use for board stuff, but I mostly just read and bookmark.
Good. Read all you want, just don't argue with strangers after a shift.
No danger there. I still haven't commented on the relay thread from last week.
If you go near the old plant by Rankin, stay outside the fence. Some floors are not good.
I am staying on the sidewalk. Just want the brick corner and the poles by the gate.
Good. Take a picture for reference only, do not climb around. Your notebook can wait.
I know. One of the accounts I watch had a good angle there, so I wanted to see it in person.
The folder from Gateway is in the basement file box. Do you need the sealed copy or just photo?
Photo should be enough. They already have the CCAC page with only that fall term on it.
Good. Also keep the lockout tag card with your work papers. Do not leave it in the truck.

events.notes: Bring USB-C cable for Ayesha. Look at Mom's insurance portal message if there is time.

events.notes: Pack rain gear, FR layers, spare gloves. Check truck bin before roll-out; possible late release if wind holds.

events.title: Run, 10 min sit, no coffee after lunch
events.notes: Recheck Highmark in-network list tonight; compare first-visit price before picking a slot.

events.title: $14 to map jar
events.notes: Add bookmarks after shift: River Rouge weekend hours; Paro permit page; brick mill walk list.

events.title: Call Dr. Feldman office before shift

events.title: Check Allegheny sample ballot + neighborhood offices
events.notes: Open county page, compare school board and magistrate writeups, save questions for Ayesha before dinner.

events.title: Watch list: ladder rung examples + feeder automation
events.notes: Open saved YT tabs after dishes: transformer oil test clip, calc warmup, then sleep.

events.title: Schenley loop before shift
events.notes: Old shoes by door; shower at rec center after if locker is open.

events.title: CCAC West Hills advising - EET night sequence

events.notes: Bring paystub, last transcript, shift calendar. Ask about two-evening lab blocks, ladder-logic module, and 70E renewal timing.

events.title: Scan old documents for renewal packet
events.notes: Look for Pittsburgh hospital record, September 2001 certificate copy, old Monroeville school address pages, and blank upload section after work-history page.

events.title: Move 425 to separate account after payroll clears
events.notes: Check stub first; February was 4300 because of extra storm hours, do not plan March around that.

events.title: Jumu'ah if route clears

events.notes: Work boots in truck; leave only if outage paperwork is finished and no rain call gets added.

events.title: Ayesha campus forum + dinner after
events.notes: Bring notebook. Ask about housing grants, streetlights, after-school slots, and who handles calls before they turn into flashing lights.

events.title: Coffee before errands

events.title: Print review + glove table notes
events.notes: Compare Maple feeder sketch with notebook; list questions for Luis: transformer bank readings, hold-point wording, visitor card for Local 29 meeting.

events.title: AHN MyChart pre-check + crew form
events.notes: Update insurance, upload meter-reader clearance PDF, leave daily bottle section unchanged, save CDC/Allegheny County link for Ammi.

events.title: Downtown steps with Ayesha
events.location: Grant St side of City-County Building, Pittsburgh
events.notes: Bring water, gloves, and the small cardboard sign from the trunk. Leave before Maghrib. No arguing with anyone filming.

events.title: Door list - Brillobox back room
events.notes: $12 cover. Keep phone low; send A. one short red-light video if the second act is good. Bring gray pencil book for bus ride home.

events.title: Open house: Carrick rowhouse

events.title: Sameer - food + old game
events.notes: Bring chips. Check whether the 2008 recording still opens on the drive.

events.notes: Bring grocery bag from Salem's. Leave before cousins stop by after 7. No brewery hoodie.

events.title: Sunday dinner at Mom and Dad's
events.notes: Bring outlet tester, pick up Ayesha's old laptop charger, ask Mom about the EOB letter before she files it.

events.title: Upload HR docs before yard

events.title: Strip District detour - notebook

events.title: Check saved posts, then phone away

events.title: Final look: storm-call notes + switch diagram

events.title: Rec center + wall day pass
events.notes: Punch card in glove box. Tape left middle finger; stretch calves after.

events.title: Phone off, stretch, breathing app

events.title: Bookmarks: recloser controls, fractions review
